summary: A steep Treasury-yield-driven sell-off weighed on equities this week, with tech shedding more than 3% and the S&P 500 finishing in the red. Roughly half of FOMC participants penciled in rate hikes for 2026 at Warsh's first meeting in June, and three regional presidents dissented in favor of hikes at his second meeting in July — an unusually high level of dissent so early in a new chair's tenure.
tweet: Rising Treasury yields hammered tech and equities this week as a near-even Fed hike/hold split for September keeps rate risk live — gold and crypto are absorbing the uncertainty.
